refusals: No real project photograph is admitted.
No real parcel, address, GIS, survey, zoning, permit, buildability, price, schedule, or construction-readiness evidence is admitted.
No third-party 3D model, stock image, HDRI, texture, vegetation pack, font, or manufacturer media is admitted by silence.
No generated raster is evidence of exact A600 geometry, physical material, real property, or completed work.
No upscaling, generative extension, scraping, purchase, or silent substitution is permitted.
join_blocker: No rights-complete real California existing-house/backyard source is admitted, and the repository's Adobe property-stage composite lacks an explicit publication/derivative license grant.
